instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPORT FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import link to the top of /app/frontend/src/index.css immediately.
2. SETUP TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (gold, blood) and font families.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: Apply the dark background gradient to the body in index.css.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components, override the default radius to 'sm' or 'none' for that sharp, luxury feel.
5. MOBILE FIRST: Always build the mobile layout first (drawer navigation, stacked grids) then expand to desktop.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
7. NO MOCKING: Implement the logic using localStorage as requested. Do not mock the data persistence.
8. USE IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds (with low opacity overlays) to create texture.

do_not: Do not use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-none).
Do not use bright blues or greens. Stick to the Gold/Blood/Black palette.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font for headings.
Do not center text by default. Use strong left alignment for a 'document' feel.
must_do: Use uppercase tracking-widest for labels and buttons.
Add subtle noise texture to the background if possible.
Use 'sonner' for notifications (styled with gold borders).
Ensure high contrast for text (White on Black).
